signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time owning platform, identity/access, or infrastructure-adjacent surfaces — not only customer-facing features
Working knowledge of IAM concepts (roles, permissions, tenancy, authorization) deep enough to have real trade-off conversations with engineering
Range across both technical platform work and user experience — credible with engineering on data models, APIs, and search performance, and a real partner to Design on UX vision…
A track record of shipping analytics or reporting products, ideally including vendor or build-vs-buy decisions for embedded BI
Experience designing for multiple personas within one product, with the configurability-vs-complexity trade-off made explicit rather than assumed
